customer_question: I clicked Forgot password three times and no reset email ever arrives. Can you just send me the reset link here?
resolution: Did not share any link in the ticket; support never sends reset links or tokens in chat. Triggered a reset email to the owner email on file and asked the customer to check spam and quarantine folders. The email was in the company's spam quarantine; their IT team allowlisted CloudFlow's sending domain. The customer reset the password within the 30-minute link validity.
